name: SIME
recent: Sime Darby 于 2026 年 11 月 12 日召开第 20 届常年股东大会及特别股东大会，所有普通决议案均获通过，包括设立长期激励计划及向集团首席执行官分配相关权益。近期公告主要为雇员公积金局（EPF）、国民投资机构（PNB）及公务员退休基金局（KWAP）等主要股东的大股东权益变动申报。
notable: 第 20 届常年股东大会于 2026 年 11 月 12 日举行，所有普通决议案获通过。
特别股东大会于 2026 年 11 月 12 日举行，通过设立长期激励计划及向集团首席执行官分配相关权益的决议。
earnings: 2026 财年（截至 6 月 30 日）营收为 MYR 167.1 亿，净利为 MYR 3.22 亿，净利率 1.9%；营收环比增长 6.1%，但净利环比下降 50.8%；营收同比下降 5.9%，净利同比下降 57.8%，净利率低于上期的 4.2%。

recent_en: Sime Darby held its 20th AGM and an EGM on 12 November 2026, where all ordinary resolutions were passed, including the establishment of a long-term incentive plan and the allocation to the Group CEO. Recent announcements mainly comprise substantial shareholder interest change filings by EPF, PNB and KWAP.
notable_en: The 20th AGM was held on 12 November 2026 and all ordinary resolutions were passed.
An EGM was held on 12 November 2026, approving the establishment of a long-term incentive plan and the allocation to the Group CEO.
earnings_en: FY2026 (ended 30 June) revenue was MYR 16.71 billion with net income of MYR 322 million and a net margin of 1.9%; revenue rose 6.1% QoQ but net income fell 50.8% QoQ; revenue declined 5.9% YoY and net income fell 57.8% YoY, with net margin lower than the prior 4.2%.
